_comment: Official ОВПО code registry, transcribed from the appendix of the MES RK '2026-2027 grant winners' PDF (_СПИСОК_ОБЛАДАТЕЛЕЙ_ОБРАЗОВАТЕЛЬНЫХ_ГРАНТОВ_НА_2026_2027_УЧЕБНЫЙ.pdf, legend pages). Canonical code -> full name + short name for every university that participates in the state grant competition. Used to (a) reconcile University rows to a stable code instead of fuzzy name matching, (b) find which grant-eligible universities are entirely missing from our DB.
